objective: Win two paid product-copywriting articles at Grow & Convert's published USD 500 per-article rate by using technically tested LazyingArt decision guides without inventing client results, acceptance, or future availability.

source_need.title: Grow & Convert business writer
source_need.published_scope: Fully remote, flexible product copywriting aimed at high-buying-intent searches. Writers use client interviews to explain product features, benefits, value propositions, and differentiators in clear English.
source_need.published_compensation: USD 500 per article. Grow & Convert says there is no fixed word count, while typical pieces are about 1,500 to 2,500 words.
source_need.published_process: The official form says submitted samples are reviewed first and the team reaches out for a phone call when it sees a fit.
source_need.assistance_policy: No explicit AI-assistance rule was found on the controlling role page or application form. Confirm the policy before accepting a test or assignment.
source_need.policy: An application, phone-call invitation, test, assignment, accepted article, confirmed payment, and received revenue are separate evidence states. Use only the official form linked from the official role page because Grow & Convert publishes an impersonation-scam warning.

application_exercise.supported_positioning: One browser-based workflow for collecting remote testimonial responses, producing branded drafts, making simple edits, and publishing or embedding finished stories.
application_exercise.not_claimed: No customer result, conversion rate, cost saving, exclusive feature, or hands-on product use was claimed.

supported_now: Technically tested product and deployment decision guides
Public software implementation behind several subjects
Clear scope, security, operational-limit, and buy-versus-build explanations
not_claimed: A Grow & Convert relationship, client byline, SEO ranking result, lead result, or product-marketing tenure
Editorial acceptance, a phone call, a test, an assignment, completed work, payment, or revenue
fit.claim_boundary: The samples establish independent technical and decision-oriented editorial work. They are not presented as client results.

application.method: Official Google Form using the LazyingArt business contact, three live public samples, concise role and career answers, and a 182-word Vocal Video exercise grounded in current official product pages
application.delivery_evidence: The visible isolated project browser showed every required field completed before one submit action. The form then displayed 'Your response has been recorded.' Private snapshots and screenshots remain outside Git.
application.operator_dependency: If Grow & Convert requests a live identity or phone interview, the named applicant must participate; an agent must not impersonate them. No such request exists now.

inbound_monitor.policy: A later aggregate increase creates a review alert only. It does not prove a human reply, qualified lead, test, assignment, payment, or revenue.

application.policy: Do not resubmit or follow up before the review date. If a human replies, confirm the exact scope, assistance policy, rights, revisions, acceptance criteria, payment route, and timing before work.
